title: ClickHouse Cloud API key secret (4b1d): one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: a 37-byte body vs exactly 38, length: a 39-byte body vs exactly 38, and length: the older 39-byte total (35 after the prefix), set aside by ruling R3 date order. Twin of "ClickHouse Cloud API key secret (4b1d): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of clickhouse-cloud-api-secret-dotenv: length: a 37-byte body vs exactly 38. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
